'''Advanced proton bombs''', also known as '''advanced bombs''', were explosive weapons carried aboard [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]]. The bombs were upgraded versions of [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] and, as the name suggests, are improvements that increase the proton bomb's explosive power.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] discovered the technology in ruins during an [[Attack on disabled base|attack]] on a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation base|base]]. He used the weapons in an [[NB-1S Royal Bomber]].<ref name="BFN" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)}}
The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], utilized the advanced proton bombs in [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighters]]. He acquired the upgrade for the bombs during Rogue Squadron's campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|six]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the pivotal [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during either the [[Raid on Balmorra]] by blowing up a domed building near a TIE landing platform, or during the [[Blockade of Chandrila]] by destroying a nearby [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]].<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
Later Rogue Squadron [[Rogue Leader/Legends|leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] also discovered the technology after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], during a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] liberation [[Raid at Bakura|raid]] at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

Certain versions of the advanced proton bomb also produced a [[Advanced spread proton bomb|cluster effect]] with bomblets.<ref name="RS II guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> Antilles discovered the upgrade during a [[Mission to Destrillion|mission]] to [[Destrillion]].<ref name="RS III" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
Antilles also discovered the technology during a [[Battle of Kothlis|battle]] with an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] over [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. The weapon in question was contained within a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that was presumably delivering it to the Star Destroyer during the battle.<ref name="RS II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Advanced proton bombs appear in the [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (series)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series. The weapons were available after picking up the upgrade in certain missions. Acquiring the technology is required for the mission's gold medal, and this article assumes the player did so.
